A '''Wookiee''' participated in the [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Battle of Kashyyyk]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]]. He was the only Wookiee to accompany the [[41st Stormtrooper Legion|41st Elite Corps]] to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to pick up [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. This Wookiee greeted Yoda when he got off of his [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|LAAT/i]].
